title: Information Propagation / Freshness
scientific_question: After controlling for target history, actual quote freshness, update timing, common-event movement and activity/liquidity, does source-market information observable at t improve the target forecast?

pair_universe_rule.discovery_eligibility: both conditions admitted by frozen EXPERIMENT-004B market_universe for the same event/regime
pair_universe_rule.challenge_eligibility: both conditions are canonical Yes conditions usable in the same 004A.2 event/regime
pair_universe_rule.direction: reference_condition_id -> target_condition_id exactly as frozen in the inventory

asof_rules.same_timestamp_conflict: conflicting valid BBO states at one observed_at are invalid until a later unambiguous state
asof_rules.quote_age: decision_time - last valid unambiguous BBO observed_at; never inferred from compressed row position
asof_rules.future_asof_state: latest valid unambiguous BBO at or before t+h; never borrow a later quote backward
asof_rules.depth_policy: full-depth values only when a valid full snapshot exists in the immediately preceding 30s feature window; missing remains missing
asof_rules.common_factor: equal-weight target-and-source-excluded mean of contemporaneous 30s innovations; no future smoothing or future-fitted loadings
asof_rules.common_factor_weighting: equal weight across currently valid other markets

models.preprocessing: training-only median imputation, then training-only mean/std scaling; explicit depth-missing indicators retained
models.fit_scope: separate model per regime; pooled across frozen source-target pairs; no pair identity feature
models.challenge_fit: refit the frozen formula on all valid discovery rows in the same regime, then score challenge events without refitting or threshold changes
models.row_weighting: within each event/regime, each frozen source-target edge receives equal total model weight regardless of valid row count
models.purge_rule: for each horizon, prior-fold rows with label_end_time >= next-fold start are purged; an additional 30s pre-boundary embargo is applied

A1.target: indicator that the target receives at least one valid unambiguous BBO update in (t,t+30s]

A2.target: signed midpoint change from state at t to the first valid unambiguous target BBO update in (t,t+30s]

A3.target: target midpoint at t+30s as-of minus target midpoint at t, including zero movement when no update occurs

decomposition.event_time_secondary: A2 first-next-target-update representation plus update latency diagnostics; it cannot replace the 30s full-grid primary

nulls.grid_rule: all source timing transforms operate on the full regular 30s event/regime grid before selecting valid target rows; never shift compressed valid-row positions
nulls.fitted_model_rule: fit the frozen baseline/challenger once on real discovery data; timing nulls transform only OOS source primitives and recompute relative-staleness/interaction features while target/common baseline and fitted coefficients remain fixed
nulls.valid_draw_rule: a stochastic draw is valid only if every observed challenge event in that regime retains at least 80% of its observed rows and at least 30 rows after the source transform; otherwise the draw is invalid
nulls.fail_closed_rule: if fewer than 250 valid draws are produced for a declared stochastic null, its inference is INCONCLUSIVE and the denominator is not reduced
nulls.NULL_A_CIRCULAR_SHIFT: independently circularly shift each source token's complete primitive feature series within event/regime by at least 10 regular 30s bins (300s), preserving its serial order and missingness
nulls.NULL_B_BLOCK_TIME_PERMUTATION: independently permute contiguous 10-bin (300s) blocks of each source token's primitive feature series within event/regime, preserving within-block order, missingness and the fixed target process
nulls.CONTROL_C_MATCHED_UNRELATED: deterministically replace the source with an unrelated condition in the frozen same-event/regime universe; exclude any condition linked to the target in the frozen pair registry, prefer the same source market_family, then lexical condition_id; no performance matching
nulls.CONTROL_D_DELAYED_SOURCE: replace source primitives by the same source's past-only values exactly 10 regular bins (300s) earlier; no future borrowing

families.A3_FULL_GRID_PRIMARY: 2 regimes x 2 stochastic timing nulls = 4 declared tests
families.A1_UPDATE_HAZARD_DIAGNOSTIC: 2 regimes x 2 stochastic timing nulls = 4 declared tests
families.A2_MARK_RESPONSE_DIAGNOSTIC: 2 regimes x 2 stochastic timing nulls = 4 declared tests

multiple_testing.per_edge_tests: not performed for headline inference; any edge summaries are descriptive only
multiple_testing.deterministic_controls: matched-unrelated and delayed-source controls are named falsification controls and receive no fabricated p-values

bootstrap.independence_warning: event bootstrap is an uncertainty diagnostic; rows and blocks do not manufacture independent elections

smallest_meaningful_effect.interpretation: at least 1% lower MSE and at least 2.5 probability-bp lower RMSE versus the target/event-only baseline

collapse_measure: report 1 - abs(controlled standardized source-return coefficient) / abs(naive standardized source-return coefficient), with undefined/near-zero naive denominator reported as unavailable rather than forced

TRANSMISSION_SURVIVES: A3 observed challenge improvement is positive and meets the smallest-meaningful-effect rule in at least one regime
the passing regime survives BH against NULL_A_CIRCULAR_SHIFT and NULL_B_BLOCK_TIME_PERMUTATION and is not contradicted by the unrelated or delayed-source controls
positive A3 improvement appears in challenge windows spanning both COL_2026 and PER_2026 event families where eligible coverage exists
source-return coefficient is directionally stable enough that no single event supplies the entire system-level result
STALENESS_EXPLAINS_STRUCTURE: A3 challenger fails to improve materially beyond the baseline after freshness/update/common-event/activity controls
naive source association materially collapses after controls
real challenger is not distinguishable from the frozen timing/source nulls
INCONCLUSIVE: coverage, event-family count, invalid null draws, instability or numerical failure prevents either conclusion
secondary horizons or subgroups may not rescue a failed 30s primary

economic_interpretation.economically_meaningful_means: predictive improvement clears the frozen smallest-meaningful-effect rule; statistical detectability alone is insufficient

complexity_gate.reduced_rank_secondary: only permissible after primary source information survives; not enabled in this preregistration

feature_formulae.relative_staleness_seconds: target_quote_age_seconds - source_quote_age_seconds; positive means target is staler
feature_formulae.log1p_depth_total: log(1 + top_bid_size + top_ask_size) from the last valid full-depth snapshot inside (t-30s,t]; no carry across feature windows

system_aggregation.row_to_edge: metric computed on the common valid row set for that edge
system_aggregation.edge_to_event: equal weight across frozen source-target edges
system_aggregation.event_to_family: equal weight across events in the event family
system_aggregation.family_to_system: equal weight across represented event families
system_aggregation.replication_gate: TRANSMISSION_SURVIVES requires positive primary challenge evidence in both COL_2026 and PER_2026 in the passing regime; a regime without eligible coverage in both families is INCONCLUSIVE_FOR_REPLICATION, not repaired by adding pairs

control_comparability.baseline_rule: baseline predictions are recomputed on exactly the same retained rows as each source null/control; baseline features themselves are unchanged

data_sufficiency.rule: insufficient cells are reported as INCONCLUSIVE and are not pooled to manufacture evidence

parameter_stability.selection_rule: champion remains 1.0 regardless of diagnostic; stability grid is evaluated on discovery OOS only and never selects challenge parameters
